results.name: Nat.size_le
results.source_text:
theorem size_le {m n : ℕ} : size m ≤ n ↔ m < 2 ^ n :=
  ⟨fun h => Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_size_self _) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) h), fun h ↦ by
    induction m using binaryRec' generalizing n with
    | zero => simp
    | bit b m e IH =>
      rw [← Nat.bit_ne_zero_iff] at e
      rw [size_bit e]
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (e (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp h)).elim
      | succ n => exact succ_le_succ (IH (bit_lt_two_pow_succ_iff.mp h))⟩

results.name: Nat.size
results.source_text:
/-- `size n` : Returns the size of a natural number in
bits i.e. the length of its binary representation -/
def size : ℕ → ℕ :=
  binaryRec 0 fun _ _ => succ

results.name: Nat.size_le_size
results.source_text:
theorem size_le_size {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : size m ≤ size n :=
  size_le.2 <| Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h (lt_size_self _)

results.name: Nat.size_pow
results.source_text:
theorem size_pow {n : ℕ} : size (2 ^ n) = n + 1 := by
  simpa [shiftLeft_eq, Nat.add_comm] using size_shiftLeft (m := 1) (by decide) n

results.name: pow_le_pow_right'
results.source_text:
@[to_additive (attr := gcongr low) nsmul_le_nsmul_left]
theorem pow_le_pow_right' {n m : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (h : n ≤ m) : a ^ n ≤ a ^ m :=
  pow_right_monotone ha h

results.name: Nat.pow_right_injective
results.source_text:
protected lemma pow_right_injective (ha : 2 ≤ a) : Injective (a ^ ·) := by
  simp [Injective, le_antisymm_iff, Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right ha]

results.name: Nat.mul_le_pow
results.source_text:
lemma mul_le_pow {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 1) (b : ℕ) :
    a * b ≤ a ^ b := by
  cases b with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ b =>
      obtain rfl | ha0 : a = 0 ∨ a > 0 := a.eq_zero_or_pos
      · rw [Nat.zero_mul]; exact Nat.zero_le _
      · have ha1 : a > 1 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne ha0 ha.symm
        rw [Nat.pow_succ']; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left a (Nat.lt_pow_self ha1)

results.name: Real.rpow_mul_natCast
results.source_text:
lemma rpow_mul_natCast (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n := by
  rw [rpow_mul hx, rpow_natCast]

results.name: NNReal.rpow_mul_natCast
results.source_text:
lemma rpow_mul_natCast (x : ℝ≥0) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n := by
  rw [rpow_mul, rpow_natCast]
